story.title: 'Happy Thanksgiving America': Jason Kelce leads reactions to Eagles' win vs. Cowboys
story.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles pulled off the largest Thanksgiving Day comeback in NFL history. Prior to Thursday, Thanksgiving Day had never seen what the Philadelphia Eagles pulled off, and it stunned social media. The Eagles defeated the Dallas Cowboys 39-38 , wiping away a 21-point deficit for the largest Thanksgiving comeback in NFL history. According to ESPN Analytics, the Cowboys had a 99.4% chance to win after Brandon Aubrey 's field goal gave Dallas a 21-point lead with 3:35 remaining in the third quarter. Instead, Philadelphia scored a touchdown on three of its next four offensive possessions. The Eagles also returned a blocked punt for a touchdown early in the fourth quarter. Dallas missed a 40-yard field goal with 3:27 left, and Philadelphia answered with another touchdown. It missed its two-point conversion, making it a 38-36 game.
